messages:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High tail latency observed for embed-service (INC-4521). 90th p99 spike > 2.5s starting 18:49:02 UTC. Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall.
Maya (oncall): saw it, pulling up dashboards.
Maya (oncall): checking recent deploys — nothing in deploy-log between 18:30-18:45.
DevOps-Bot: Autoscaler event: 3->1 scaling due to node pressure at 18:40:13.
Priya: Node pressure? any OOMs?
Maya (oncall): kube events show repeated pod eviction on embed-worker-*. Logs show KV cache thrash: "kvcache evicted entries=1200"
Ravi: looks like KV cache churn -> cold cache misses -> longer generation times. Could be causal.
Carlos: immediate mitigation idea: increase pool size and pin a smaller quantized model variant to reduce per-token latency. Can we scale to reserved pool?
Maya (oncall): scaling now to 6 replicas in prod to absorb traffic. running:
```
kubectl scale deployment embed-service -n prod --replicas=6
```
Maya (oncall): also toggled model-routing to fallback-quantized via config flip in runtime console (rollout id: ro_814).
DevOps-Bot: Scale command accepted. New pods pending.
Maya (oncall): health checks passing on new pods, latency trending down. Good.
Priya: Can you capture a quick customer impact summary for CS? Which customers hit errors or duration > 2s?
Maya (oncall): querying traces... found ~1200 requests >2s from two API keys (acct-acme and acct-finn). No 5xxs, just degraded latency.
Carlos: thanks. I'll message CS with a heads-up and link to incident.
Emma: I've created a Jira ticket TRACKER-789 to capture action items and write the post-incident doc.
Maya (oncall): handoff to Carlos for 20:00-08:00 shift. leaving notes in thread. Key mitigations: scaled replicas, fallback-quantized routing, increased cache capacity (temp).
Carlos: taking handoff. pls add runbook steps to ticket so follow-on oncall can repeat.
Maya (oncall): done. runbook snippet added under TRACKER-789: steps to flip routing, scale command, and telemetry queries.
Ravi: preliminary RCA hypothesis: node-level eviction + aggressive cache eviction codepath that doesn't backpressure correctly under concurrency. Might be regression in kvcache eviction heuristics from last week.
Priya: can we repro in staging? I'm spinning up a load test against staging with kvcache configured the same.
Emma: scheduling postmortem write-up and brown-bag shareout. Proposed times: Thurs 10:30am or Fri 4:00pm. Preferred audience: eng, eng-sre, eng-runtime, product.
Carlos: Thurs 10:30 works for me.
Maya (oncall): works for me.
Ravi: Friday is fine too but prefer Thurs to close loop faster.
Emma: OK booked Thurs 10:30am. Calendar invite sent. Owner: Emma to present timeline + actions, Ravi to present technical root cause, Priya to cover repro + test plan.
Carlos: action items (from thread) — list: 1) Update kvcache eviction to add backpressure (owner Ravi, due 2w). 2) Add defensive autoscaler step to avoid scaling down below 3 replicas if kvcache QPS > X (owner Priya, due 1w). 3) Add synthetic latency test to prod-like staging and run daily (owner Priya, due 1w). 4) Update runbook with explicit fallback-routing play (owner Maya, due 3 days). 5) Notify affected customers and prepare SLA notes (owner Carlos, due today EOD).
Priya: I'll attach load test results to TRACKER-789 when ready.
Emma: also recommend a retro/brown-bag slide deck template — I'll start it.
Carlos: quick note for oncall: add an alert that triggers when kvcache evictions/sec > 100 and p99 > 1.5s, so we get earlier signal.
Maya (oncall): adding that to monitoring now.
DevOps-Bot: Created alert rule: kvcache.evictions > 100 for 5m -> Pager.
Ravi: one more item: add unit/integration test for eviction policy behavior under concurrency. I'll open PR after triage.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. I'll update CS thread with customer impact summary and mitigation steps.
Carlos: noted. I'll own the postmortem write-up if Emma needs help.
Emma: TY. I'll link the final postmortem and slides in TRACKER-789 and post here after.
Maya (oncall): handing off—Carlos has the incident -> closing paging rotation.
Carlos: confirmed. leaving a short summary for next oncall: scaling + routing flip fixed latency, root cause likely kvcache eviction heuristics interacting poorly with node pressure. Next steps in TRACKER-789.
Emma: :thumbsup: closing notes — brown-bag invites with dial-in and recording enabled.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-4521 auto-updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[Carlos, Emma], postmortem_required=true.
Carlos: thanks, everyone.
